posts.summary_en: v1.5.002, released 10-08 16:00 KST. Chardonnay Cookie: SSR Grass support, range 5.25, skill prep 75%, first cast 1 s, 4 s cooldown; a 1x8 barrier for 5 s giving crit +60% to +120% and push RES +40% to +60% by stars, Volley 1 to 2, damage 194% to 250% of ATK; receives Projectile Speed. In-game note: push RES isn't affected by Skill AMP. Cookie cap 100 to 120 (account levels 105 and 200 in the expansion data). Rumble Season 2: battles 10-08 14:00 to 10-21 12:00 KST. New Eternal Lv.95 sword, helmet and armor. Lineups copy and paste as a code, Arena defense included. Arena help explains how Mercenary Guild effects apply. Arena shows a notice when another battle is running. Plating shows its costs. No balance change to any cookie, pet or PvP rule.

Arena: Season 6 runs 10-08 16:00 to 10-22 12:00 KST (page times in CEST); Season 5 ended 10-08 12:00 KST. Rumble: Season 2, battles end 10-21 12:00 KST, no next season listed; passives 'Charge Cookie Max HP +30%' and '+30% DMG Reduction for all Allies and summons'. Both modes: 60 s battles, five opponents (one stronger, two similar, two weaker), refresh 300 crystals or free every 30 min, records kept 5 days, damage up at 30 s and 15 s left. Tiers show hidden cookies on defense: 4 at Grandmaster and Champion, 3 at Elite Master, 2 at Master, 1 at Diamond; top tiers drop to 1,300 trophies after a season. Arena tier cut-offs: Champion 1-3 the top 3 at 3,200; Grandmaster 1-3 top 5/10/30 at 3,000; Elite Master 1-5 top 75 to 750 at 2,000.

Updated 10-10 16:17Z. Arena grouped: the Chardonnay Bari-Oven-Cherry Cola group leads at 23.2%, the Macaron Rye / Skating / Grapevine group 14.7% (falling), the five-ranged deck 13.9%, Seeker-Rye-Rockstar 5.0%. Arena lineups: Chardonnay standard 5.1%, Macaron standard 5.0%, Chardonnay standard with Rockstar for Herb 3.5%, Macaron Rye 3.3%, Chardonnay Rye / Skating / Grapevine 2.3%. Chardonnay is in 29.6% of Arena lineups; Macaron fell from 93.1% to 48.4%, Rye from 72.9% to 49.3%, Oven rose from 22.3% to 36.3%. Rumble grouped: Chardonnay standard 50.7%, Chardonnay Rye / Skating / Rockstar 23.3%. Rumble lineups: Chardonnay standard 18.0%, Macaron standard 9.1%, Chardonnay standard with Rockstar 8.6%, Chardonnay Rye / Skating / Rockstar 4.4%. Macaron fell from 99.7% to 43.3% of Rumble lineups. Every listed lineup's captain is Milk, and nearly all run Passion Pay + Rapid Promotion. Sample and method unstated.

Most common pet sets: Holy Baby Drop + Icy Birdie + King Choco Drop 35, Holy Baby Drop + Hot Doggie + King Choco Drop 30.

posts.title_en: crumb.gg equipment pages: the Eternal Lv.95 pieces and their Lv.100 counterparts
posts.summary_en: Sticky Allulose Lance (sword), Ticking Time Hat (helmet) and Soft Waffle Cape (armor) are Eternal pieces fixed at Lv.95 with fixed sub-stats: the lance ATK 5,829 with accuracy 181.7 and crit 22.08%; the hat DEF 5,829 with HP 10,812 and crit RES 22.08%; the cape HP 76,951 with DEF 770 and DR 6.9%. The Lv.100 Eternal sword and helmet show 6,392 at Lv.100 and the armor 85,239, with rolled sub-stats.
